name: Crew App Branding
description: Branding, logo design, and design system for a social media startup.

text: Crew is a social media startup that connects influencers with brands. They needed a visual identity that felt familiar to creators but stood apart from the polished, corporate look of existing platforms.
I designed the logo, brand system, color palette, and typography. The goal was to capture something the competitors missed entirely. Playfulness.

Every other platform in this space leans into clean, professional design. Functional, but flat. Crew wanted the opposite. The brand needed to feel like a celebration, not a corporate partnership dashboard.
Confetti became the central motif. It represents festivity, individuality, and the energy of creator culture. The zigzag shapes scatter across the brand, giving every surface a sense of occasion.
The Crew logo is built entirely from confetti. Each letter is constructed from the same zigzag shapes that make up the brand pattern, so the wordmark and the visual system are one and the same.

The palette pulls from the primary colors of CMYK, adjusted for screens. Pink, teal, and yellow. Each of these colors is already claimed individually by major social platforms. Combining all three gives Crew a vibrant, energetic identity that nods to the broader social media landscape without belonging to any single player.
Satoshi by Indian Type Foundry was chosen for its clean geometry and warmth. It stays readable at every scale while complementing the playful brand elements without competing with them.
This was Crew's existing brand before the redesign. It worked, but the yellow and black palette felt generic and didn't reflect the energy of the creator community it served.

An early variation explored a more professional, subdued aesthetic. The confetti shapes are still present, but muted and glowing against a dark background. The team ultimately chose the vibrant direction, which better matched the personality of their users.
